title: Shikantaza
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of balancing insight (understanding) with serenity (openness), as neglecting one can lead to imbalance. When these two aspects come together, a state of silent illumination is fulfilled, allowing for awakening and union with reality. This balance can be cultivated through the practice of zazen, which combines physical postures with mindfulness and awareness, ultimately leading to a more open and compassionate way of being.
